doc.name: Photo Mosaic & AI Collage Maker - Collager.ai
doc.description: Photo mosaic maker and AI photo collage maker. Starts photo mosaics - one picture recreated from hundreds of the user's own photos - and makes photo collages in seconds: a heart, a number, a word, a star or a flower (watermarked preview + link to the full-resolution file on collager.ai).

skills.name: Photo mosaic maker
skills.description: Recreate one main photo from hundreds of small photos. Returns the link where the user uploads the photos on collager.ai; the preview is ready in minutes. Developers with a key use the REST API https://api.collager.ai/v1 (OpenAPI: https://collager.ai/developers/openapi.yaml).
examples: I want a photo mosaic of my dog made of all his photos

skills.name: Photo collage maker
skills.description: Arrange 1-300 photos into a photo collage shaped as a heart, a number (birthday, anniversary), a word, "I love you", a star or a flower. Send the photos as URL/file parts (or links in the text) and say the shape in the text, or pass a data part {"shape": {"type": "number", "text": "30"}}. Returns a watermarked preview image and a link to the full-resolution file.
examples: Make a photo collage from these photos
Make the number 30 out of these photos
Make a heart collage from these photos
